items.summary: Recommendation: keep SearchWoot private and authorize only a report-only draft of a written permission request for owner and Legal review. Official API access does not establish redistribution rights, and legal, security, accuracy, attribution, and measurement gates remain blocked. Existing scored candidates are not actionable for new queue work because they are active, measuring, failed, or under repair. Owner decision: authorize draft-only preparation without sending outreach or changing the gate?

Recommendation: do not queue new implementation this cycle. The available scored candidates are already active, measuring, failed, or under repair; duplicate queue work would increase backlog while 27 requests remain failed and 124 approved proposals lack execution.
